none: PAS CAM-6E3EE6: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS].REI PVBLICAE . Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Obverse type and legend illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: //[ ]. Condition is fair. Die axis illegible. Weight 1.95g, diameter 12.69
